answer: Proof of unique IP ASN diversity over time turns identity into something scarce. Because an ASN history that changes like a real user, the horizon of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Honest agents barely notice the check, because an ASN history that changes like a real user is something they already have; the forge falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm doing the maths finds the mirror first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
